name: free_memory_and_clear_flag
description: Calls the Exec free-memory library vector three times in a loop, with calls to unnamed routines between them, then reads a field of a resident structure and, if a masked value matches, saves and clears a global flag cell.

name: busy_wait_short_counter
description: Counts a 16-bit register down until it wraps to minus one, a busy-wait delay loop with no other effect.

name: free_blocks_and_reset_flag
description: Calls the Exec free-memory library vector three times in a loop, then compares a masked field of a resident structure against a different constant and, on a match, saves and zeroes another global flag cell.

name: busy_wait_short_counter
description: Counts a 16-bit register down until it wraps to minus one, a busy-wait delay loop with no other effect.

name: copy_sixteen_longwords_to_buffer
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed offset in the base structure into the caller's buffer when the buffer pointer is non-null, then calls a library vector.

name: build_context_block_table
description: Scans a linked list for the largest size value, fills a table with an ascending sequence of tags, and stores a stack reference and a callback address into it. It returns minus one when one of its library calls fails and zero otherwise.

description: Allocates a message block through the library and, when a command-line argument block is present, splits the raw argument string into null-terminated words, honouring double quotes and the star escapes for newline and escape. The message block is released through the library before the routine returns a result code.

name: select_fast_and_chip_blocks
description: Walks a memory list from a global pointer and picks the first fast-memory node of one type and the first chip-memory node of another type. When both are found and differ, it calls two routines to process the fast block with the list and the chip block.

name: build_context_block_table
description: Scans a linked list for the largest size value, fills a table with an ascending sequence of tags, and stores a stack reference and a callback address into it. It returns minus one when one of its library calls fails and zero otherwise.

name: copy_sixteen_longwords_to_buffer
description: Copies sixteen 32-bit words from a fixed offset in the base structure into the caller's buffer when the buffer pointer is non-null, then calls a library vector.

name: parse_arguments_and_open_nil
description: Allocates a message block through the library and, on the command-line path, splits the argument string into words honouring quotes and star escapes. It opens the NIL: device and tears the block down again if the open fails.

name: close_handles_and_reply
description: Stores its argument as the return value in a process record, closes a stored DOS handle and library if present, forbids task switching and replies to a startup message when one exists, then frees the record and returns the stored value.

name: start_tool_from_resident_tag
description: Decodes an XOR-obfuscated string table, allocates a small setup block, and starts a named tool through a resident-tag lookup. It reports failure text when the lookup or the start fails.

name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two null-terminated strings byte by byte, returning minus one if the first sorts before the second, one if it sorts after, and zero when they are identical.

name: build_linked_list_from_table
description: Walks a pointer table and allocates a cleared eight-byte node for each entry, storing the entry's value in the node and linking the nodes in order. It returns the first node, or null when an allocation fails.

name: forbid_task_switching
description: Calls the Exec Forbid vector on the library base held in a global, disabling task switching. It returns nothing.

name: permit_task_switching
description: Calls the Exec Permit vector on the library base held in a global, re-enabling task switching. It returns nothing.

name: match_release_prefix_and_pad
description: Checks whether a text buffer begins with a fixed release string; when the buffer's character at index twenty is the digit two and the full text matches, it writes a dot and four spaces into the five positions that follow.

name: write_dot_and_four_spaces
description: Writes a dot followed by four spaces into five consecutive bytes of the buffer, starting at offset seventeen.

name: compare_buffer_against_fixed_text
description: Advances through a buffer and a fixed text in step, comparing byte by byte until the fixed text ends. The comparison result is not stored or returned, so only the pointer progress remains.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return instruction and so performs no action. Three routines reference its address.

name: forward_params_with_stack_slot
description: Passes its two incoming parameters, together with the address of a local stack slot, to another routine and then returns.

name: format_message_and_forward
description: Formats a message into a 140-byte stack buffer through the Exec RawDoFmt vector, then scans the buffer for its terminator to measure the length. When the text is non-empty it passes the text and its length to an unnamed routine.

name: parse_command_line_arguments
description: Allocates a message block through the library and, when a command-line argument block is present, splits the raw argument string into null-terminated words, honouring double quotes and the star escapes for newline and escape. The message block is released through the library before the routine returns a result code.

name: reply_and_release_record
description: Stores its argument as the return value in a process record, closes a stored library if present, forbids task switching and replies to a startup message when one exists, then frees the record and returns the stored value.

name: check_library_version
description: Parses the command-line arguments to open a named library or device and reads its version and revision from the library base. It compares these with the user's thresholds and prints usage, open-error and version messages before closing the handle.

name: release_block_and_call_routine
description: Releases one 128-byte block through the library's free-memory vector, then hands the second argument to an unnamed routine.

name: parse_signed_decimal_string
description: Reads an optional plus or minus sign and then decimal digits from a string, accumulating them into an integer and negating it for a minus sign.

name: compare_null_terminated_strings
description: Compares two null-terminated strings byte by byte, returning minus one if the first sorts before the second, one if it sorts after, and zero when they are identical.

name: calculate_string_length
description: Walks a null-terminated string up to its terminator and returns the number of characters before it.

name: call_reschedule_vector
description: Calls the Exec Reschedule vector on the library base held in a global, letting other tasks run. It returns nothing.

name: call_dispatch_vector
description: Calls the Exec Dispatch vector on the library base held in a global, handing control to the task scheduler. It returns nothing.

name: forward_params_with_stack_slot
description: Passes its two incoming parameters, together with the address of a local stack slot, to another routine and then returns.

name: call_alloc_mem_vector
description: Calls the Exec AllocMem vector on the library base held in a global, passing through the caller's register arguments and returning the result.

name: call_close_library_vector
description: Calls the Exec CloseLibrary vector on the library base held in a global. It returns nothing.

name: call_open_library_vector
description: Calls the Exec OpenLibrary vector on the library base held in a global, passing through the caller's register arguments and returning the result.

name: format_message_and_forward
description: Formats a message into a 140-byte stack buffer through the Exec RawDoFmt vector, then scans the buffer for its terminator to measure the length. When the text is non-empty it passes the text and its length to an unnamed routine.

name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the data register to the address held in the pointer register, with no other effect.

name: free_memory_then_clear_flag
description: Calls the Exec free-memory library vector three times in a loop, interleaved with calls to other routines, then compares a masked field of a resident structure with a constant and, on a match, saves and zeroes another global flag cell.

name: busy_wait_short_counter
description: Counts a 16-bit register down until it wraps to minus one, a busy-wait delay loop with no other effect.

name: unpack_rnc_compressed_record
description: Searches a linked list of memory records for one tagged with the RNC compression signature, makes room for the packed data and unpacks it from literal and back-reference codes. Each unpacked byte is XORed with a 16-bit key that rotates after each literal run.

name: extract_flag_bit_from_table
description: Scans a table of word pairs until one pair matches a masked value, then reads two per-entry bytes to shift and mask the value and sets one bit in the result. It calls an unnamed routine first when a byte comparison underflows.

name: mask_word_or_call_routine
description: ANDs two 16-bit values and, when one byte is smaller than another, calls another routine and returns its word in place of the masked value.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

name: build_canonical_prefix_table
description: Reads a count and that many byte values into a buffer, then loops over bit lengths from one to sixteen. For each length it assigns code values in the manner of a canonical prefix code and stores masks, symbol values and lengths in a table.

name: apply_hunk_relocations
description: When a hunk header carries the relocation marker, clears the marker and walks the relocation list. For each listed offset it adds the base address of the target hunk to the longword stored there.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: The decoded instructions are invalid and the decompiler halts, so this is a stub or bad data with no reliable behaviour to describe.

name: stub_overlapping_instruction_data
description: The decoded instructions overlap and the decompiler halts on bad data, so the body is not reliable. It is a stub or bad data, and no behaviour can be stated from it.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Its final instruction is invalid and the decompiler halts, so the routine is a stub or bad data with no reliable behaviour to describe.

name: calculate_linear_offset
description: Multiplies a 16-bit value by a 16-bit field of a table entry, then adds another 16-bit value and a 32-bit field of the same entry, returning the sum as an offset.

name: call_routine_then_clear_word
description: Calls one unnamed routine and then writes zero to a 16-bit field at a fixed offset from a structure pointer. It returns nothing.

name: shift_word_with_conditional_xor
description: Shifts a 16-bit value right arithmetically by one and, when the original lowest bit is zero, XORs the result with the low word of a second argument before returning it.

name: xor_third_arg_word
description: Returns the exclusive-or of the low 16 bits of the third argument with a 16-bit register value. The first two arguments are not used.

name: check_flags_then_call_routine
description: Calls another routine when the 16-bit argument is below sixteen, or when a flag bit is set and the matching structure field is non-zero. The routine always returns zero.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return and performs no work.

name: call_fixed_address_routine
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then calls a fixed-address routine with two fields from its structure and a fixed constant, and calls that routine again when a 16-bit field is non-zero.

name: test_table_bit_from_argument
description: Returns one when the upper half of its argument is negative. Otherwise, when the lower half is below four, it returns the bit at the position given by the upper half within a per-row byte table; larger rows return zero.

name: test_table_bit_from_registers
description: Returns one when the row register is below four and the bit tested is set in a per-row byte table, and zero otherwise.

name: test_table_bit_unchecked
description: Returns the bit at the position given by a register from a per-row byte table, with no range check on the row.

name: return_fixed_status_code
description: Returns a fixed status value of one hundred and does nothing else.

name: return_fixed_status_code
description: Returns a fixed status value of one hundred and does nothing else.

name: increment_counter_clear_bit
description: Increments a 16-bit counter at a fixed offset in a structure and clears one flag bit in a byte of the same structure. This is library code from the icon library, not game code.

name: decrement_refcount_and_cleanup
description: Decrements a 16-bit reference count in a structure and, when the count reaches zero and a flag bit is set, calls a cleanup routine. Otherwise it returns zero. This is library code from the icon library.

name: unlink_and_free_node
description: When a 16-bit count field is zero, it unlinks the structure from its neighbours, frees the block through the library free-memory vector and returns a stored 32-bit value. Otherwise it sets a flag bit in the structure and returns zero. This is library code from the icon library.

name: set_flag_bit_return_zero
description: Sets one flag bit in a byte of the structure and returns zero. This is library code from the icon library.

name: open_named_library_or_alert
description: Stores two arguments in the structure, calls a library vector on the base in its register to open a library, and saves the returned base in two globals. When the result is zero, it calls the Exec Alert vector instead. This is library code from the icon library.

name: copy_two_longs_into_globals
description: Copies two 32-bit fields from a structure into two global variables and returns.

name: store_value_in_returned_record
description: Calls a library vector on the base passed in, then stores the second argument into a 32-bit field of the pointer that call returns. This is library code from the icon library.

name: chain_two_calls_with_release
description: Calls a first routine with the last two arguments and, when it returns a non-null result, calls a second routine with that result. If the second call fails it releases the result through a third routine and returns zero. This is library code from the icon library.

name: read_fields_into_record
description: Obtains a record, reads its saved fields into a stack buffer through a stream routine and copies them into the record, then links it to a parent record. If the read fails it releases the record and returns zero. This is library code from the icon library.

name: copy_record_fields_from_stack
description: Copies ten longwords and several scalar fields from a stack buffer into a record, then updates the back-link of the record's linked parent. This is library code from the icon library.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero and does nothing else. It is an empty stub in the icon library.

name: copy_icon_data_to_stack
description: Copies ten longwords and several fields from a record into a local stack block that starts with a fixed tag word and a version word, then passes that block with the first two arguments to another routine. This is library code from the icon library.

name: load_disk_object_file
description: Reads a .info icon file into a disk object. It checks the magic word and version, then reads the image and gadget data into newly allocated blocks, releasing them and returning zero on any failure. This is library code from the icon library.

name: read_disk_object_body
description: Checks the magic word and version of a disk object and reads its image and gadget data into newly allocated blocks through the library, returning zero on any failure. This is library code from the icon library.

name: read_icon_optional_blocks
description: Reads two longword fields, then reads optional image, list and extra data blocks into the record. It returns one when every read succeeds and zero otherwise. This is library code from the icon library.

name: read_icon_pointer_list
description: Reads a null-terminated list of longword entries into memory, reducing the remaining size for each entry, and then reads an optional trailing block. It returns one on success and zero on failure. This is library code from the icon library.

name: call_one_routine_return_zero
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns zero. This is library code from the icon library.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return and performs no work. This is library code from the icon library.

name: write_disk_object_file
description: Allocates a 260-byte work buffer, writes the disk object's fields and its image, gadget and list blocks through stream routines, then frees the buffer. It returns one on success and zero on failure, and reports a fixed error code when the buffer cannot be allocated. This is library code from the icon library.

name: write_disk_object_body
description: Writes a disk object's image, gadget and list blocks through stream routines using a work buffer passed in a register, and returns one on success and zero on failure. This is library code from the icon library.

name: write_icon_optional_blocks
description: Writes the optional list and extra data blocks of a disk object through stream routines, returning one on success and zero on failure. This is library code from the icon library.

name: write_icon_pointer_list
description: Walks a null-terminated list of longword entries, writing each through a stream routine, then writes an optional trailing block. It returns one on success and zero on failure. This is library code from the icon library.

name: iterate_icon_table_entries
description: Walks a null-terminated table of pointers and, for each entry, records its size and calls a stream routine twice. It then processes an optional trailing entry and returns one on success and zero on failure. This is library code from the icon library.

name: walk_node_chain_with_callback
description: Walks a circular linked list starting after the given node, calling a routine on each node until the list loops back, then calls the routine once more on the last node found. This is library code from the icon library.

name: iterate_linked_list_nodes
description: Repeatedly calls a routine on the current node and advances along the links, stopping when the next link is null or the list loops back. A final node is handled once more after the loop. This is library code from the icon library.

name: call_with_record_offset_pointer
description: Calls another routine with the same first argument and the second argument advanced by a fixed offset of 140 bytes, then returns. This is library code from the icon library.

name: allocate_disk_object_record
description: Allocates a cleared 168-byte record and runs a routine on part of it. On success it runs a second routine on the record and returns it if that also succeeds; otherwise it releases the record and returns zero. This is library code from the icon library.

name: call_routines_and_return
description: Calls unnamed routines and returns, with no other operations. This is library code from the icon library.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero and does nothing else. This is library code from the icon library.

name: store_pair_in_table_slot
description: Decrements a 16-bit count in a list header and, when no entries remain, asks a routine for more space. It stores the two arguments as a pair in the table slot at the new count and returns one, or zero when no space can be obtained. This is library code from the icon library.

name: decrement_counter_and_store_pair
description: Decrements a 16-bit count through a pointer, then stores two register values into consecutive entries of the table selected by that count. It returns one. This is library code from the icon library.

name: allocate_icon_record_block
description: Allocates a cleared 94-byte record, runs a routine on part of it and then a second routine on the record. On any failure it releases the record and returns zero; otherwise it returns the record. This is library code from the icon library.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return and performs no work. This is library code from the icon library.

name: call_one_routine_return_zero
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns zero. This is library code from the icon library.

name: call_with_field_offset_pointer
description: Calls another routine with the same first argument and the second argument advanced by 78 bytes, then returns. This is library code from the icon library.

name: find_key_value_after_equals
description: Walks a null-terminated list of strings, testing each with a matching routine, and returns the text after the equals sign of the first match. It returns null when no entry matches. This is library code from the icon library.

name: find_next_equals_entry
description: Advances through a null-terminated list of strings until a matching routine accepts an entry whose character at a given offset is an equals sign, then returns the text after that sign. It returns null when the list ends. This is library code from the icon library.

name: scan_list_for_equals_entry
description: Walks a null-terminated pointer list, calling a matching routine on each string, and returns the text after the equals sign of the first accepted entry. It returns null at the end of the list. This is library code from the icon library.

name: find_matching_pipe_segment
description: Walks a string separated by vertical bar characters, looking for a segment whose length equals a computed length and which passes a comparison routine. It returns one when such a segment is found and zero otherwise. This is library code from the icon library.

name: scan_pipe_segments_for_length
description: Walks segments separated by vertical bars and returns one as soon as a segment's length equals the expected length and a check routine accepts it. Otherwise it returns zero. This is library code from the icon library.

name: scan_pipe_segments_with_check
description: Walks vertical-bar separated segments and returns one when a segment's length equals the expected length and the check routine accepts it. It returns zero when no segment qualifies. This is library code from the icon library.

name: find_pipe_segment_with_check
description: Walks vertical-bar separated segments until one has the expected length and passes a check routine, then returns one. It returns zero when the segments run out. This is library code from the icon library.

name: search_pipe_segments_for_length
description: Walks segments separated by vertical bars, testing each segment's length against the expected value and calling a check routine on the match. It returns one when a segment passes and zero otherwise. This is library code from the icon library.

name: parse_copy_counter_name
description: Checks whether a name begins with the copy prefix, reads the decimal counter that follows it and stores the next copy label in the record. When the name lacks the prefix it stores the default copy label instead. This is library code from the icon library.

name: parse_copy_counter_value
description: Checks for the copy prefix, reads the decimal copy number that follows it and, when the number is valid, finishes the parse with two unnamed routines. Otherwise it finishes without writing a number. This is library code from the icon library.

name: parse_decimal_digits_prefix
description: Reads decimal digits from a string into a running value, then checks the following text against a fixed string. It calls two unnamed routines to finish the step. This is library code from the icon library.

name: parse_copy_number_digits
description: Accumulates decimal digits from a string into a number, then compares the remaining text against a fixed string. It calls two unnamed routines in either case. This is library code from the icon library.

name: convert_decimal_digit_char
description: Returns the numeric value of a character when it is a decimal digit, and minus one otherwise. This is library code from the icon library.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Returns minus one and does nothing else. This is library code from the icon library.

name: call_alloc_mem_vector
description: Calls the Exec AllocMem vector on the library base stored in a global and returns nothing. This is library code from the icon library.

name: call_free_mem_vector
description: Calls the Exec FreeMem vector on the library base stored in a global and returns nothing. This is library code from the icon library.

name: chain_two_calls_with_release
description: Calls a first routine with the last two arguments and, when it returns a non-null result, calls a second routine with that result. If the second call fails it releases the result through a third routine and returns zero. This is library code from the icon library.

name: allocate_counted_record_block
description: Allocates a cleared 96-byte record, stores a count of ten in the record and in a caller's word, passes the record on to a routine, and returns one when the allocation succeeded. This is library code from the icon library.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero and does nothing else. This is library code from the icon library.

name: call_and_check_result
description: Calls a routine with three arguments and returns its result when it equals the fourth argument, otherwise zero. This is library code from the icon library.

name: call_and_check_result
description: Calls a routine with three arguments and returns its result when it equals the fourth argument, otherwise zero. This is library code from the icon library.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return and performs no work. This is library code from the icon library.

name: divide_32_by_16_unsigned
description: Divides a 32-bit value by a 16-bit divisor and returns the quotient and remainder. When the divisor fits the high half it uses a sixteen-step shift-and-subtract loop, otherwise it uses the native divide operations. This is library code from the icon library.

name: run_division_loop_no_result
description: Runs the sixteen-step shift-and-subtract division loop on a dividend and divisor, but returns nothing, so the quotient it builds is discarded. This is library code from the icon library.

name: multiply_32_bit_integers
description: Computes the low 32 bits of the product of two 32-bit values from 16-bit partial products, and returns it together with the second value with its halves swapped. This is library code from the icon library.

name: call_raw_do_fmt_vector
description: Calls the Exec RawDoFmt vector on the library base stored in a global and returns nothing. This is library code from the icon library.

name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the data register to the address held in the pointer register, with no other effect. This is library code from the icon library.

name: calculate_string_length
description: Counts the characters of a null-terminated string by decrementing an accumulator for each one and returning its complement. This is library code from the icon library.

name: find_character_in_string
description: Returns a pointer to the first occurrence of a given character in a null-terminated string, or null when the character is absent. This is library code from the icon library.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero and does nothing else. This is library code from the icon library.

name: copy_c_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination until the terminating zero byte has been copied. This is library code from the icon library.

name: append_c_string
description: Advances to the terminator of the destination string and copies the source string, including its terminator, onto the end of it. This is library code from the icon library.

name: compare_strings_up_to_length
description: Compares up to a given number of characters of two strings and returns one when a difference is found. It returns zero when they match through the terminator or when the count runs out. This is library code from the icon library.

name: return_one_stub
description: Returns one and does nothing else. This is library code from the icon library.

name: scan_string_up_to_limit
description: Advances through a string for at most a given number of characters and calls one unnamed routine when the terminator is reached. It returns nothing. This is library code from the icon library.

name: call_one_routine_and_return
description: Calls one unnamed routine and returns, with no other operations. This is library code from the icon library.

name: copy_string_with_bounded_padding
description: Copies up to a given number of bytes from a source string into a destination, stopping after the terminator, then fills the rest of the destination with zero bytes. This is library code from the icon library.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return and performs no work. This is library code from the icon library.

name: setup_pointer_chain
description: Stores the block's own address plus four in its first longword, clears the next longword and stores the block's address in the third. This is library code from the icon library.

name: process_icon_request
description: Returns one for a null record pointer. Otherwise it calls a routine with the constant twenty and, on success, calls two more routines, the last using a pointer field of the record, and returns that result. This is library code from the icon library.

name: walk_records_with_two_calls
description: Walks a linked list of records and, for each one, calls one routine with a fixed size of sixteen and a second routine with the record's pointer and a size scaled from a byte field. It returns one when the list ends and zero when a call fails. This is library code from the icon library.

name: walk_record_links_checking_calls
description: Repeatedly runs two unnamed routines on the current record and follows its next link. It returns one when the link ends and zero when either call returns zero. This is library code from the icon library.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero and does nothing else. This is library code from the icon library.

name: allocate_record_with_buffer
description: Allocates a cleared 20-byte record, fills it through two routines, then makes a second allocation whose size comes from a returned value and stores its pointer in the record. It returns the record on success and minus one on failure. This is library code from the icon library.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Returns minus one and does nothing else. This is library code from the icon library.

name: build_record_chain
description: Allocates a cleared 16-byte record for each step of a count, links each record to the previous one, and fills its buffer pointer through routines. It returns the first record, or minus one if any allocation or call fails. This is library code from the icon library.

name: build_record_chain_until_end
description: Builds a chain of records through routines, linking each new record to the previous one, until a record without a next link is reached. It returns the first record, or minus one if a step fails. This is library code from the icon library.

name: build_record_chain_with_checks
description: Builds a chain of records through routines, linking each record to its predecessor and checking every step. It returns the first record, or minus one when a step fails. This is library code from the icon library.

name: return_minus_one_stub
description: Returns minus one and does nothing else. This is library code from the icon library.

name: check_and_set_font_handle
description: Calls a library vector on the base and, when the returned pointer is non-null, stores the argument in a 32-bit field of it and calls a second library vector. It returns whether the pointer was non-null. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: check_and_set_font_handle
description: Calls a library vector on the base and, when the returned pointer is non-null, stores the argument in a 32-bit field of it and calls a second library vector. It returns whether the pointer was non-null. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: open_libraries_and_init_list
description: Opens the DOS and graphics libraries and, when both opens succeed, initialises a list header inside the given block and returns the block. Otherwise it closes the library it opened, frees the block and returns zero. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: close_library_and_free_block
description: Closes a library through its library vector, frees the given block through the free-memory vector, and returns zero. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: release_font_entries_and_unload
description: Walks a list of font entries, unlinking and unloading each entry whose use count is below one through the DOS unload vector. When no users remain it closes both libraries, frees the block and returns a stored value; otherwise it sets a flag bit and returns zero. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: close_and_free_when_unused
description: When the use count is zero, closes two libraries, unlinks the block from its list, frees it and returns a stored value. Otherwise it sets a flag bit and returns zero. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: set_high_flag_return_zero
description: Sets the top flag bit of a byte in the structure and returns zero. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: return_without_action
description: Contains only a return and performs no work. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: clear_flag_and_increment_counter
description: Clears the top flag bit of a byte in the structure and increments a 16-bit counter at a fixed offset. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: decrement_and_call_vector
description: Decrements a 16-bit counter in the structure and, when it reaches zero while a flag bit is set, calls a library vector and returns its result. Otherwise it returns zero. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: scan_font_directory_entries
description: Copies font names into a buffer and, for each font file it can read, checks the font contents header and adds an entry for it. It returns the magnitude of a negative result, or zero. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: copy_font_names_then_scan
description: Copies font names into a buffer, then checks the font contents header of each matching font file and adds an entry for it. It returns the magnitude of a negative result, or zero. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: scan_font_names_from_buffer
description: Splits a buffer of font names, copies each name into the output buffer and adds an entry for each font whose header passes a check. It returns the magnitude of a negative result, or zero. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: scan_fonts_directory_path
description: Walks the FONTS directory using DOS locks, examine and current-directory calls, and reads the font contents header of each matching font file to add an entry. It returns the magnitude of a negative result, or zero. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: scan_font_files_in_directory
description: Examines directory entries for font files, copies each name into a buffer and opens the file to read its font contents header, adding an entry for each valid one. It returns the magnitude of a negative result, or zero. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: scan_font_entries_until_done
description: Walks font names and their directory entries, checking each font contents header and adding entries to a buffer until the entries run out. It returns the magnitude of a negative result, or zero. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: read_font_names_from_file
description: Reads font name bytes from a file through the DOS read call, copies each completed name into a buffer and adds entries for valid font contents headers. It returns the magnitude of a negative result, or zero. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: walk_directory_entries_with_examine
description: Walks directory entries with the DOS examine-next call, reads font contents headers, adds entries to a buffer and releases locks and memory on exit. It returns the magnitude of a negative result, or zero. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: return_zero_stub
description: Returns zero and does nothing else. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: compute_font_match_score
description: Scores how closely two font descriptors match by comparing a size field, then, over seven flag bit positions, subtracting table weights for each differing bit. A missing size in the second descriptor gives a fixed large negative score. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: score_font_flag_differences
description: Subtracts table weights from a starting value for each bit that differs between two style bytes, over seven bit positions, and returns the result. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: decode_bit_tree_value
description: Walks a seven-level bit tree selected by the bits of two bytes, subtracting a table entry at each level, and returns the accumulated value. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: decode_bit_tree_variant
description: Walks a seven-level bit tree in a similar way to its neighbour, subtracting table entries as the bits are read, and returns the accumulated value. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: return_fixed_negative_constant
description: Returns a fixed negative 32-bit constant and uses no arguments or registers. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: select_best_matching_font
description: Finds the font entry for a requested name and size, scores the candidate entries from a font directory and records the best match, opening the chosen font through the graphics library. It returns the chosen entry or zero. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: scan_fonts_directory_for_matches
description: Locks the FONTS directory, reads the font contents header of each candidate file, scores the candidates and adds the best matches to the font list. It releases its locks before it returns the last recorded entry. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: scan_font_file_candidates
description: Reads font contents headers from candidate files in a directory, scores them and records the best matches in the font list. It returns the last recorded entry. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: add_best_scoring_font_entries
description: Repeatedly picks the highest-scoring candidate from a table of font entries, adds it to the font list and releases its temporary entries. It returns the last entry added. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: queue_best_font_entries
description: Repeatedly picks the highest-scoring candidate, loads its code segment through the DOS library, adds the font to the graphics font list and returns the last entry added. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: unload_best_font_entries
description: Walks candidate font entries, releasing each loaded segment through the DOS unload call and adding the best-scoring entries to the list. It returns the last entry recorded. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: close_font_entries_and_free
description: Walks candidate font entries, closing the fonts and locks each one holds and freeing their memory, while recording the remaining entries in the list. It returns the last entry recorded. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: build_font_entry_table
description: Locks a font directory, counts its entries, allocates a block sized for them and writes a font contents header into it. It then reads each matching font entry into the block, returns the block or zero on failure, and releases its locks. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: load_disk_font_table
description: Counts the entries of a directory listing, allocates a block sized for them and fills its header. It then copies each matching font's name and style fields into the table through DOS directory calls, and returns the table or zero when the listing fails. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: dispatch_stacked_pointer_pair
description: Reads a longword from the stack slot below its argument and passes that slot's address and value to another routine. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: forbid_task_switching
description: Calls the Exec Forbid vector on the library base stored in a global, disabling task switching. It returns nothing. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: permit_task_switching
description: Calls the Exec Permit vector on the library base stored in a global, re-enabling task switching. It returns nothing. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: call_alloc_mem_vector
description: Calls the Exec AllocMem vector on the library base stored in a global and returns nothing. This is library code from the diskfont library.

name: copy_c_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string to a destination until the terminating zero byte has been copied. This is library code from the diskfont library.
